statement.zh: 主张只经所识的差别被否证，相对于模型的否证是对模型与主张一起的否证。成员只经自己之识回应时，识闭包之外的在其中不被识；检验是关系的。
statement.en: A claim is refuted only through a difference in what registers, and refutation relative to a model refutes the model and the claim together. Where members respond only through their own registration, nothing beyond the registration closure registers within it; testing is relational.

laws.zh: 形成识它的支持（水平是否接纳它）与它所观察之条件的水平；基础只识支持。在两个水平历史之下，在某步水平同样接纳它、所观察的条件同样立着，就是识得相同；直到某步每步如此，就是直到该步识得相同。
laws.en: A formation registers its support (whether the levels admit it) and the levels of the conditions it observes; the base registers support only. Under two level histories it registers alike at a step when the levels admit it alike and its observed conditions stand alike, and alike up to a step when it does so at every step up to it.

laws.zh: 其余所识条件相同时，依存而不观察的条件只以是否满足所需被识；观察的条件以其水平被识；观察得更多分辨得更多。
laws.en: With every other registered condition alike, a condition depended on and not observed registers only whether it meets the need; an observed one registers its level; observing more distinguishes more.

laws.zh: 关于水平历史的主张在某步被否证，是指满足它的历史没有一个直到该步与实际识得相同：主张只经所识的差别被否证，成立的永不被否证，否证此后一直成立，观察得更多否证得更多。
laws.en: A claim about level histories is refuted at a step when no history meeting it registers alike with the actual one up to that step: a claim is refuted only through a difference in what registers, what holds is never refuted, a refutation stands, and observing more refutes more.

laws.zh: 没有模型时，对任何有限的记录，“某条件将归于无”与“它此后一直在无之上”都不被否证。
laws.en: Without a model, for any finite record, neither the claim that a condition comes to nothing nor the claim that it stays above nothing afterwards is refuted.

laws.zh: 相对于模型（可容许历史的类）的否证恰是对模型与主张一起的否证；以流的平衡水平历史为模型、实际历史是其中之一时，观察储量的形成在第一步否证一切“它将归于无”的假主张；错的模型否证成立的，识否证模型。
laws.en: Refutation relative to a model, a class of admissible histories, is exactly refutation of the model and the claim together; relative to a flow's balanced level histories, the actual one among them, a formation observing a stock refutes at the first step every false claim that it comes to nothing; a wrong model refutes what holds, and registration refutes the model.

laws.zh: 形成的信念是与实际识得相同的历史；否证是主张与信念不交；由识作出的判断恰是 Becoming.Inquiry 中判断过程在信念上的共同回应，更晚的步与更多的观察都保持它。
laws.en: A formation's belief is the histories registering alike with the actual one; refutation is a claim disjoint from the belief; a judgment from registration is exactly a common response of the judging process of Becoming.Inquiry over the belief, kept as later steps and more observation narrow it.

laws.zh: 形成依存于或观察一个条件就识它；识闭包是对经所识者受影响的闭包，含影响闭包，只识支持时就是它，随观察与交换增大。
laws.en: A formation registers a condition when it depends on it or observes it; the registration closure is the closure under being affected through what is registered, holding the influence closure, equal to it registering support only, and growing with observation and exchange.

laws.zh: 两个流相同的形成在场、在一个区域的成员所识的每个条件上逐步平衡，区域在两个流中都对经所识者受影响封闭，水平起始在成员所识的条件上相同，每个成员在自己识得相同之处对成员所识的条件同样取用与给予时，每个成员每步都识得相同。
laws.en: For two flows with the same formations present, balancing at each step on every condition a member of a region registers, the region closed in both under being affected through what is registered, the levels starting alike on what members register, and each member taking from and giving to what members register alike wherever it has registered alike, every member registers alike at every step.

laws.zh: 其余交换固定、在识闭包内所识的条件上逐步平衡时：成员都在识闭包之外的部分，闭包之内每步有与无它都识得相同；无部分的水平所满足的主张在闭包之内不被否证；相对于模型的否证靠模型对部分之交换的排除；闭包之内的判断在有与无部分时都可容许。
laws.en: With the rest of the exchange fixed and balance at each step on what is registered within the closure, a part whose members all lie beyond the registration closure is registered alike with and without it at every step within it; no claim met by the levels without it is refuted there; a refutation there relative to a model rests on the model excluding its exchange; a judgment there is admissible with and without it.

laws.zh: Clearing 中清除者每步都识得相同，无论清除是否终结栖居者；在不清除的世界中，“栖居者已被终结”被清除者在任何一步都不否证，被栖居者在第三步否证；“第三步栖居者或清除者不被接纳”，两者各自都不否证，合起来否证。
laws.en: In Clearing the clearer registers alike at every step whether or not its clearing ends the dweller; with the habitat spared, the claim that the dweller is ended is refuted by the clearer at no step and by the dweller at the third step; the claim that the dweller or the clearer is not admitted at the third step is refuted by neither alone and by the two together.

laws.zh: 以固定起始与交换的模型，清除者在第一步否证它不识的。
laws.en: With a model fixing the start and the exchange, the clearer refutes at the first step what it does not register.

laws.zh: Prey 中不依存于自身的猎物，捕食者在其影响闭包之外、量度自身时的识闭包之内：猎物经支持每步把捕食者的部分识得相同，量度自身则在被咬之后识其取用；这靠被省略的关系。
laws.en: In Prey, the prey not depending on itself, the predator lies beyond its influence closure and within its registration closure under a gauge of itself: the prey registers the predator's part alike through support at every step, and the gauge registers the taking after the bite; this rests on omitted relations.

hypotheses.zh: 识与否证的定义不设前提；模型是给出的可容许历史类。
hypotheses.en: The definitions of registration and refutation assume nothing; a model is a supplied class of admissible histories.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡只在被识的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn，单元素家族，不需要有限性）；整体的平衡经 Flow.Balances.on 给出它。
hypotheses.en: Balance is assumed only on the conditions registered, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.

hypotheses.zh: Flow.alike_within_closed 另设区域在两个流中封闭、起始相同与成员只经自己之识回应，都是给出的假设：他者怎样回应是给出的。有与无部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels，其余交换不变，是表示上的选择）；部分是判定的形成家族。
hypotheses.en: Flow.alike_within_closed further assumes the region closed in both flows, the starts alike, and the members responding only through their own registration, all supplied: how others respond is supplied. The comparison with and without a part uses withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels, the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation); a part is a decided family of formations.

hypotheses.zh: 识：支持与所观察条件的水平（obs，参数）；活动由表示给出，不算作被识。否证是对一个形成、在一步、在一个水平历史之下的；主张是关于水平历史的任何命题。
hypotheses.en: Registration: support and the levels of the conditions observed (obs, a parameter); activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as registered. Refutation is by one formation, at a step, under one level history; a claim is any proposition about level histories.

hypotheses.zh: 形成自身的立着是否算作被识（Ren 的第 4 问）由 AI 探索后决定：基础只识支持（supportOnly）；一类读法中自身的立着经承担自身（Web.SelfBearing）作为阈值被识；量度自身（ownStanding）是观察前提。理由见整合文档。
hypotheses.en: Whether a formation's own standing counts as registered (Ren's question 4) was decided by the AI after exploring the options: the base registers support only (supportOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing registers through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing) as a threshold; a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is an observation premise. The reasons are in the integration note.

hypotheses.zh: 见证的结论：各见证的流、网与模型（Clearing、Prey、Stationary）。
hypotheses.en: For the witnesses: their flows, webs and models (Clearing, Prey, Stationary).

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量；条件上的判定相等（DecidableEq）只在按条件分情形处使用，不用经典推理。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

does_not_show.zh: 反馈的三种不见各只在其范围内成立：阈下在交换随识之处，视界之外在延续开放之处，识闭包之外在成员只经自己之识回应之处。
does_not_show.en: Each feedback blindness holds only in its scope: below threshold where exchange follows registration, beyond the horizon where continuation is open, beyond the registration closure where members respond only through their own registration.

does_not_show.zh: 这些规律不推出形成观察支持之外的任何东西、形成模型、想要检验或知道其识闭包。
does_not_show.en: The laws do not derive that a formation observes anything beyond its support, forms a model, wants to test or knows its registration closure.

does_not_show.zh: 识得相同界定能分辨的，不说一个差别关于什么。
does_not_show.en: Registering alike bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.

does_not_show.zh: 一个动作造成什么是对两段历史的比较，只相对于无此动作之历史的模型才可检验；变动自己的动作并识差别（实验）在这里没有陈述。
does_not_show.en: What an act does compares two histories and is testable only relative to a model of the history without it; varying one's own act and registering the difference (experiment) is not stated here.

detail.zh: 相对于模型的否证可以出错：Stationary 中模型说没有取用与给予，相对于它，量度储量的形成在第一步否证“储量将归于无”，而这在实际中成立（Stationary.model_error）。
detail.en: Refutation relative to a model can err: in Stationary the model says nothing takes or gives, and relative to it a formation gauging the stock refutes at the first step the claim that the stock comes to nothing, which holds of the actual history (Stationary.model_error).

detail.zh: 识闭包可以严格大于影响闭包：Prey 中捕食者在猎物的影响闭包之外，量度自身时在其识闭包之内（Prey.couples_taking）；所识的差别对猎物不起作用，猎物不承担自身（Prey.omits），所以这一见证靠被省略的关系。
detail.en: The registration closure can be strictly larger than the influence closure: in Prey the predator lies beyond the prey's influence closure and, under a gauge of itself, within its registration closure (Prey.couples_taking); the registered difference does nothing to the prey, which does not bear on itself (Prey.omits), so the witness rests on omitted relations.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议：“can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”，“I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”。AI 的回答提出反馈的三种不见、失控是在其一之中运行的回路、跨过它们的方式、可否证性是被展开纠正的条件，以及 理 的读法；Ren 答：“agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”。独立审查收窄了这些读法：三种不见各有其范围（见“未表明”）；失控的读法是启发，不是陈述；理 原由 AI 读作对识负责的模型，现依 Ren 2026-10-12 的读法，为对结构与变化之规律的建模；模型仍只经识被检验（generalization-through-lumping）。所以记录中的读法是 AI 收窄之后的，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D26），不是 Ren 所接受的原文。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (a does-not-show item states it); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理, read by the AI as a model answerable to registration, is now read as Ren read it on 12 October 2026, the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; a model is still tested only through registration (generalization-through-lumping). So the readings here are the AI's narrowed ones, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D26), not the wording Ren accepted.

history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the claim became 12 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, hypotheses, standard boundaries and next_delta; the evidence became one paragraph. Three laws state conditions their theorems carry that the old text left to context: the threshold law, “with every other registered condition alike” (alike_of_threshold's others); the stock law, “the actual one among them” (refutes_tail_within's history); the fixed-rest law, “balance at each step on what is registered within the closure” (balanced). The Prey sentence now says what the theorem says: the prey registers the predator's part alike through support at every step, and the gauge of its own standing registers the taking after the bite (the old “registering alike … and through the gauge after the bite” could be misread). “No Lean axiom is used”, with no ethical premise among the hypotheses, cites the standard boundary no-ethical-premise. In the correspondence, the scopes of the three blindnesses became the first does-not-show item and the sentence on 理 was condensed, keeping both the replaced reading and Ren's; the decision on question 4 moved to the hypotheses; the history of the name “registers” moved here: its Chinese was 计入, as in P42; Ren found it “apparently weird” and asked for a better word, the AI proposed 反映, and Ren chose 识 (“for registers, use 识”): a difference showing in the formation's state (§70.2 of the integration note; the old Chinese correspondence had an unreplaced placeholder §{SEC}.2 there, the English §70.2). In the limitations, “the multi-step Scope bridge remains open” is carried by next_delta, and “how others respond is supplied” joined the response hypothesis. The parentheses of P65, P66 and P73 in next_delta are completed connections and are kept here: P66 states which projections carry a model (exactly those under which configurations alike go alike, projection-carrying-a-law), P73 when a model's generalization is right (exactly where the world goes alike across what it lumps, generalization-through-lumping), and P65 supplies that the rest responds through its registration and decides the comparison within the responsive reach; “what a registration is about (calibration)” and “learning where registration does not tell values apart (below threshold)” are shortened to “calibration” and “learning below threshold”. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [testing-within-registration.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/testing-within-registration.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
